violations.description: Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Cover hotel pans of shredded meat in lower level walk in freezer.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Lower shelving under prep counter at cook line has build up and needs cleaning. Counters under grill have food build up and need cleaning.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in the proper location to protect from contamination. Service utensils being stored/rolled near load dock. Unprotected area.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. Hand wash sink loose on wall near concession area of 3rd floor catering kitchen.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Soap dispenser empty at hand sink near concession area of 3rd floor catering kitchen.--Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towel dispenser empty at hand sink near concession area of 3rd floor catering kitchen.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Replace missing ceiling tiles in 3rd floor catering kitchen.

Preventing contamination by consumers. — --Food on display for self service was not properly protected by food guards, display cases, or similarly effective means. Buffet style tables for food display and service not provided with sneeze protection.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Minor detail cleaning needed.
Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. Conveyor dish machine leaking water.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Pooling water from leaking dish machine.
